notes: Yamabuki Akari (山吹灯), 18, 1st-year university student in Kyoto, Literature faculty. Brown wavy hair. Good at housework. Narrator.

Touma.name: Touma
Touma.personality: Looks cool and mature but is easygoing and a bit odd (orders the weird dishes); fluent English; messy home
Touma.speech_style: Calm, direct, warm; says kind things plainly
notes: Aihara Touma (蓝原藤真), 18, 1st year, Literature faculty, from Tokyo, lives alone in Kyoto. Dark straight hair, mole under the eye.
Birthday 6 December (doesn't care about birthdays). Loves omurice. Has dimples when he smiles.

Backstory (ch.3): only child of busy parents in Tokyo, often home alone; blunt as a child, called scary for not smiling; studied hard only to please his parents; popular later but unchanged inside; chose a Kyoto university on a whim to go somewhere far and new. Noticed Akari helping a lost student at the entrance ceremony and decided to befriend him -- the first time he ever spoke to someone first. Wants Akari to call him by name. Avoids crowds/festivals (turned down all Gion invitations).
